ana: Heads up — ACME asked to move their tenant SSO pilot up by ~3 weeks. If we don’t cut scope we’ll miss the milestone. Quick sync on what to trim?

sam: TL;DR proposal: defer admin UI + bulk export + multi-region routing. Keep core inference, embeddings cache, and model pinning.

riyad: Agree on keeping cache + pinning for determinism. Multi-region is big. Admin UI is the obvious cut. Need to check policy/compliance impact if pilot is single-region. @jules any blockers?

jules: Compliance is OK for a single-region pilot if contract amends residency clause. I can draft the amendment but need legal looped in.

emma: Also call out we can’t cut tenant-level RBAC completely — basic RBAC must stay for pilot. Anything that affects data isolation is non-starter.

ana: (typo) ana: Good call — keep basic RBAC. Proposed cutlist to hit the new date: 
- defer Admin UI (v1.1)
- defer multi-region routing (v1.1)
- defer bulk export / analytics export (v1.1)
- defer advanced RBAC roles (keep basic)
This should buy ~3 weeks.

sam: Operational constraints: need a QA perf gate and a canary plan. My suggestion: p95 < 300ms for text-gen on pilot traffic, and error rate <0.5% on canary window.

riyad: Canary execution: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% over 48h. Auto-rollback triggers: error rate > 0.7% or p95 > 500ms sustained for 15m.

jules: Add to go/no-go: legal sign-off on amendment, infra reserved capacity commit, runbook present, oncall rota assigned, and canary metrics dashboard.

ana: (typo again) ana: Acceptance criteria draft (will land PRD shortly):
```
- Legal amendment in contract for single-region pilot: signed
- Infra commit: Dedicated pool reserved for pilot (capacity ticket + cost commit)
- Perf gate: p95 < 300ms on pilot traffic profile
- Reliability gate: error rate < 0.5% during canary
- Observability: route-level traces + token-level cost on dashboard
- Rollback plan + owner assigned
```

sam: I can own the canary dashboard and rollback play. Will set up alerting for the thresholds above. :+1:

riyad: I’ll write the e2e QA test that simulates 3 tenant workloads (concurrent sessions + embeddings lookups) and validate cache hit ratios.

jules: Legal pinged. Emma, can you confirm we can ship basic RBAC without the admin UI?

emma: Yes — basic RBAC APIs + limited CLI controls are sufficient for pilot. Admin UI required for v1.1. :ok_hand:

ana: Ok next steps: I’ll publish a 1-pager PRD and update milestone dates. Sam to own canary dashboard. Riya(d) to own QA test. Jules to draft contract amendment and loop legal. Emma to confirm runbook items.

release-bot: deploy-notice: created release candidate 2024-11-05_rc-3 for pilot with tags: v1-pilot-cut1

sam: One ask — can we keep a small rollout buffer (burst capacity budget $8k/mo) to handle initial spikes? Need finance sign-off, but it’s safer.

jules: Noted. I’ll include cost cap in amendment appendix.

ana: Thanks all — I’ll update the milestone tracker and flag the timeline reset in the roadmap doc. Meeting in 30 to finalize cuts. :eyes:
